reasoning: ChatRunSpan (native_view_chat.rs:1734-1738) is {start,end,flags}. Adding fg/bg touches 9 literal constructions in native_view_chat.rs plus 1 in native_view.rs:3957, and both splice/resize paths in native_view.rs (:3440,:3573,:3607) which reconstruct spans. The paint loop consumes run_spans TWICE (tui_entry.rs:4859 and :4900, plus :4857-4878 markdown bg). Adding fields is mechanical but the ingestion (the hard part) is not.

ChatRunSpan is derived from markdown_runs::parse_part over PROSE (markdown_part_row_spans_mode :1755). A split diff row is not prose and its spans are positional columns, not markdown flags. There is no existing producer that turns SplitRow::Pair into ChatRunSpans with per-side bg. That adapter must be written (new function + its own column-composition for the String row text).

config.diffs.view has no producer (foundation Config lacks diffs). Adding it requires a new Config field, default, validation and a live layer. Separately native_permissions.rs:188 diff_view already duplicates the resolve_view_mode logic with a DIFFERENT contract (permission auto-splits at >120 with no viewer branch); wiring both would create two split-resolution authorities.

Two live painters must both be re-routed: push_diff_fence (:2190) currently returns bool and only accepts Unified rows (:2212-2217 fail-closed guard would reject Split rows), and ChatPart::Patch (:2721-2821) has its own budget/malformed/diagnostics row math keyed to unified line.text. Split rows pair two lines into one row, changing all of total_rows/kept/truncated math.

Net: not a 3-step bounded patch; it is a config field + row-model extension + span producer + two painter rewrites + the fail-closed guard rework. >5 coordinated seams across 3 files, one of which (row model type) propagates to native_view.rs.
